programmes.d: Best friends Maisy Odjick and Shannon Alexander go missing after a school dance. When police label the girls as runaways, Maisy's family picks up the search.
When Chase Hurdle walks out of high school one morning, his family wonders if he's experiencing amnesia, or if something more sinister has happened.
An abandoned car raises new questions about whether it was Chase or someone else seen jumping from a Bismarck bridge. Did Daniel Olson come to town to start over, or end it all?
When 22-year old Mackenzie Trottier doesn't show up for Christmas, her family panics. Police hunt for an unidentified man connected to the missing woman.
Gabby Petito's road trip turns tragic, with social media driving the search and revealing her murder.
Ali Abulaban's online fame turned deadly, resulting in cold-blooded murder and a trail of digital evidence.
The murder of Daisy De La O sparked the viral movement #JusticeforDaisy, leading to her killer's conviction.
Teen gamer Breck Bednar was groomed online by Lewis Daynes, leading to a shocking and tragic murder.
Podcast host Zohreh Sadeghi and her husband were murdered by a stalker despite her seeking a protective order.
Ellen Higginbottom was killed in a premeditated attack. Her final movements were documented on social media.
Nik Bird was fatally shot. A series of chilling Facebook posts led police to an obsessed stalker.
A dating app connected Gordon Semple to his killer, who murdered him after the two arranged a simple date.

In 1954, the fairy-tale life of Dr. Sam Sheppard shattered with the bludgeoning death of his pregnant wife Marilyn. Though Sam claimed a bushy-haired intruder injured him, the doctor was charged with murder.
In 1999, for only the second time in history, a President of the United States went through trial before the Senate after being impeached by the House of Representatives.
Shannon Mohr was killed by her husband David Davis, who took out huge insurance policies on her within two months of their marriage.
Story of Thomas Capano, the powerful former Delaware prosecutor who was sentenced to death for the murder of his ex-lover.

The case of Robert Diaz, a hospital worker accused of killing 12 patients by giving them an overdose of the common heart-regulating drug lidocaine. Diaz is on San Quentin's death row for his crimes but maintains his innocence.

The shocking saga of Barbara Stager, a suburban mom who appeared to be a devoted wife and mother, but whose secret extramarital affairs and expensive taste led her to murder her first and second husbands.
Abducted in the trunk of her own car, a woman suffers unimaginable horror at the hands of her three captors.
A machete-wielding intruder terrorizes a woman in her apartment; and a savage attack by a grizzly bear leaves a man partially scalped and miles from help.
After leaving the SEALs in 2017, Ephraim Mattos joined the Free Burma Rangers risking his life to rescue civilians and document ISIS atrocities. He was shot rescuing a girl under sniper fire.
Members of SEAL Team Six go on a top secret mission to take out Osama bin Laden. Despite their helicopter crashing, the SEALs complete the mission and Osama bin Laden is dead.
Scott Mann, a retired Green Beret officer, receives the text that changes his life. His old friend Nezam, an Afghan commando, is being hunted. Scott embarks on a mission to save his friend.
The terror group ISIS forced women into sex slavery. Delta Force operator Jeff Tiegs brokers a tense deal with a ruthless ISIS gangster, ultimately freeing 250 Yazidi women.
Two months after 9/11, ODA-574 helped Karzai's forces secure Tarin Kowt. A misdirected airstrike killed three Green Berets. Karzai was named interim leader. The Taliban surrendered by Dec 5.
In 1989 US forces went to rescue CIA operative Kurt Muse in Panama. On December 20, Dale Comstock and James Dietderich fly in to find Muse. Dietderich's plane crashes, but Muse is rescued.
U.S. Special Forces hunted al-Qaeda leader Abu Musab al-Zarqawi. Interrogator Tony Camerino leads raids, but can he break a suspect to track Zarqawi's location?
In late 1989, U.S. forces invaded Panama to remove Noriega. Army Rangers, including Tony Ely, Kurt Harsh, and Nick Benzschawel, secured airfields despite injuries and continued the mission.
In late 1989, U.S. forces invaded Panama to remove Noriega. Army Rangers, including Tony Ely, Kurt Harsh, and Nick Benzschawel, secured airfields despite injuries. Noriega surrenders.
The "Horse Soldiers," led by Mark Nutsch and Bob Pennington, used horseback riding to navigate Afghan terrain after 9/11. They worked with local warlords to deliver major blows to the Taliban.
In 1991, Gregory Green stabbed his first wife to death, killing not only her but also their unborn child.
In 1991, the bodies of sex workers started being discovered in Detroit, Michigan.
After two couples were brutally murdered three years apart, both cases went cold for almost three decades.
